snippet.title: Ball Scratch Simulator – Official Trailer (PC + VR).
snippet.description:
Your balls itch.
You are in public.
This is now everybody’s problem.

An immersive experience where every second of relief could destroy your dignity. Scratch when nobody is looking, freeze when they turn around, and chase the perfect run through six wildly inappropriate public places.

Play on desktop, or make it worse in VR.

Wishlist Ball Scratch Simulator on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/49...

Coming August 21, 2026.
